title: crotalaria polysperma subsp. stewartii
intro: Crotalaria polysperma subsp. stewartii, commonly known as a shrubby species of the Crotalaria genus, is a type of flowering plant in the legume family. The plant has been reported to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Crotalaria polysperma subsp. stewartii include wound healing, antipyretic, and analgesic activities, attributed to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which have been identified as responsible for its medicinal properties.
